system.description:
Water becomes like ice to the ensorcelled feet of the witch. The recipient of this spell may tread upon water as if it were solid ground. White/rough water counts as unstable ground—at least +1 Ob to all actions. The character can climb rapids with Speed and/or Climbing tests.

Obstacle: 5. Actions: 4.

Origin: Personal | Area of Effect: Caster or Single Target | Element: Anima | Impetus: Control | Duration: Sustained | Resource Points: 10

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 221
